title: Forms Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 📋️forms plugin (single-app, single-artifact) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree, following the W1 flow pilot's TEMPLATE.md exactly. Preserve package name, all [package.metadata.*] verbatim. Exclusive ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms/**.
